description: This file implements the RunC container management class and related functionalities, including container creation, execution, state retrieval, and deletion, using the runc runtime. It defines classes for container info, configuration, and the runner that interfaces with the runc command-line tool.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Manages container lifecycle commands (create, exec, delete, state, list) by invoking the runc CLI.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Holds container process ID and status information, deserialized from runc's state output.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including environment variables.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds environment variables for the container process.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via runc, providing start, stop, status, and resource info methods.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing multiple runc containers.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers managed by runc.

methods.name: InheritHostEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Reads environment variables from the host and passes them to the container configuration.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Factory method to create a container instance from configuration files.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Configures logging for containers (not implemented, only logs info).

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Stops and removes the container if it is running.
